# Workflow v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's workflow/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.WorkflowV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.workflow`).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.WorkflowV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Workflows.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Workflows.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
